name: MicroBooNE
summary: MicroBooNE is located at Fermilab, Batavia, Illinois. The neutrino detector conducts original dark-sector analyses; electron or neutrino anomalies cannot directly be treated as dark matter.
detection_principle: A liquid-argon TPC performs topology searches for dark matter produced by the off-axis NuMI beam. In the dark-trident mechanism, a dark particle scatters on argon and radiates a dark photon that decays to e⁺e⁻.

science_scope: Tests dark-sector models by producing candidate particles or portal mediators at accelerators. Invisible accelerator final states or mediator particles alone do not establish cosmic-dark-matter identity; lifetimes, abundance and other experiments must also be considered.
